layouts.name: KIP
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The operator Main Track plan identifies the full 14-corner circuit, retaining the western S bend and both northern and eastern hairpins. The independent course uses raceway ways 360618173-176 and 128947452; the angular southern access alternative is excluded. Its unchanged source-node length is 1264.8 m, close to the operator 1270 m. The catalogue scalar is 2480 m and is kept separate; the discrepancy does not justify stretching coordinates. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1264.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
